action_instruction: Checking whether the page background is dark
intent: whether the page background is dark

action_params.condition: the page background is still dark
action_params.query: whether the page background is dark
action_params.code_js: (() => { const n = el(2).closest('.app') || el(2).ownerDocument.body; const c = getComputedStyle(n).backgroundColor; const m = c.match(/\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g); if (!m || m.length < 3) return null; const [r,g,b] = m.slice(0,3).map(Number); const luminance = 0.2126*r + 0.7152*g + 0.0722*b; return luminance < 64; })()

assertion_tree.description: the page background is still dark

sub_results.description: the page background is still dark

assertion_tree.verification: the current page shows a dark background
